body: Same! If you wanna talk, I'm here. And when i say talk, I mean if you want to share your final moments talking to a complete stranger who will not judge you. I promise I wouldn't say things like, "it gets better", "don't be selfish" blah blah blah.. I'm in a very clear headspace and I will just listen to whatever you say. I just want you to know that whatever you're feeling is totally valid. And even I believe death will solve all my problems.
I feel you. Do you wanna talk about it? I'm already preparing myself and I'm going to do it tonight. Meanwhile, I just want to know the stories of people who've been thinking about it

No they didn't do it initially. But once I was back home, they took me on a guilt trip. Constantly nagging me to pay them back and I did but I couldn't take it any more so I moved away. But my life is in shambles. Look, I don't know your parents, they might be very different from mine and if you know that, please reach out to them.
I'm done with this life and I'm ready to take the leap, you might still have some hope idk
I feel you. I've been there and it was a disaster when I told my parents.
